Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly simulates future urban land expansion (a LULC class) across the entire territory of China—meeting the national-scale criterion. The primary objective is to simulate future urban expansion and evaluate its impacts, with LULC prediction as the central methodological focus. The study implements five localized Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) as distinct future scenarios and quantitatively compares outcomes (e.g., urban land increase ranges, habitat loss by scenario). It uses an improved spatially explicit model (LUSD-urban coupled with CNN) and reports quantitative accuracy metrics (OA = 99.45%, Kappa = 0.73, FoM = 0.26; 15–32% improvement over benchmarks). Mapped projections of urban land from 2020 to 2050 are produced and analyzed at national, biome, and ecoregional scales. All core inclusion criteria are satisfied, and no exclusion criteria apply.)
